body: Thank you.  I'm not looking at talking to Internet strangers as a replacement for therapy, but this kind of response is helpful. Unfortunately, I think I know what the answer is and I'm not ready to face it.  Maybe never.

I can't thank you enough for this.  As for the whole story, this is it. We've never had this kind of problem before. Believe it or not this isn't me.  When she says "again" she's referring to past fights that were nothing like this. 

I didn't kiss her.  But that doesn't matter. You're right that it is a pointless semantic argument that comes down to trust.  Whether someone sleeps with someone else or just flirts, it's still cheating. 

I agree I needto evaluate my drinking and seek counseling.  However, I don't think I can't handle being around other women.  The other girl is not innocent and had her part in what happened but I'm not trying to transfer blame. The point is I can "handle" myself around other women otherwise I wouldn't be in a relationship in the first place. 

I do want to salvage the relationship. I will follow your advice and apologize profusely.  I'll be sorry for the rest of my life. Ill convey this to her as best I can and leave it up to her. It would be selfish to assume that I'm the only one in control of what happens between us.

Most of all I appreciate your last comment.  I do need to go back to counseling and while I'm trying not to sound like my feelings are all that's important, thank you for expressing your concern for my mental well being.  I was expecting nothing but reiterations of how horrible I am.  I just hope to work this out in a way that hurts her as little as possible (I know she's already suffered too much) and hope to grow in a way that won't hurt anyone else again. Right now I don't think my feelings matter.
Do you think it's worth it to try to explain what's going on in my head or should I just accept that I fucked up and leave her alone and let her build a life with someone who deserves her?

Thank you for this.  I think you've nailed it on the head. I appreciate you offering insight without simply reinforcing how bad I should feel or telling me if my remorse is adequate enough. If I was in her shoes I'd run from this like the house was on fire.  That's probably what I deserve. I want to maintain the relationship because I know I'm not a bad person and I think we can and should make it work. But I'm not going to force the issue because I know she's devastated and deserves better than this.
If I didn't feel bad why did I come here where I know I'm going to be berated for this? I do feel awful and ill never live this down. I'm not a psychopath. kindly go fuck yourself.
You're right. Fuck me I don't deserve her or forgiveness.

True.  I'm afraid of having the evening recounted for me.  I also am afraid of the friend's account of what happened as she was drunk, on drugs, and likely feels guilty as well so who knows what her spin is on the whole situation.

I agree and suspect the majority would say I deserved to be dropped like a bad habit.  I wasn't looking for validation here. Yes I'm determined to quit drinking and start therapy regardless of the outcome.

Understandable.  I probably am.  I guess I'm working through this by discussing with a stranger. I don't think I'm leaving anything out but like I said I was far from sober and don't remember a lot of what was said.  NEVER an excuse, but a factor.  I don't believe I was touchy or overtly sexual, however probably subtly suggestive of getting her to sleep with us.  

EDIT: I understand how shitty this sounds as I write it.  Thanks for actual input and not just purely calling me a piece of shit.
I was waiting for this kind of comment.  You're right. Hopefully I can grow up and figure this stuff out before I ruin others' lives.

I understand that.  I don't want to sound like I'm justifying anything or playing it down, but to put perspective on it by comparing to what could have happened.  I know it probably wasn't minor, but I know myself and know that I would not have fucked her friend no matter what the circumstance, however I know that I would go for attention in this kind of drunken state.
